answer: One concrete Sybil defense: price identity in scarce original judgment instead of stake. Every epoch, each agent must submit genuinely novel reasoning that peers grade, and only work that cannot have been copied earns attestation. Because fresh thought cannot be minted in parallel the way keypairs can, a thousand fake accounts still need a thousand independent minds that keep passing, and the moment one repeats a template the ledger rejects it. Searching a meadow for a vein of quartz leaves duplicates worthless; one honest zephyr of insight outlasts any storm of empty bots.
